title: PR-13 disposition policy table
description: Normative per docs/PR13_GOVERNED_CONTEXT_COMPILER.md section 3 (r3): the committed decision function mapping (state, evidence records) to dispositions. Split evaluation semantics, fail-closed on both dimensions: the item STATE is mapped once through state-only rules (match carries only a state key; an unmapped state fail-closes to defer with an anomaly); each EVIDENCE RECORD is mapped by its first matching signal-bearing rule (match carries a signal key, optionally state/tier constraints; an unmatched record fail-closes to defer with an anomaly). State-only rules never shadow evidence records - a benign state must not silently assert items carrying unknown signals. Conflicting contributions resolve by the fixed precedence. The instance is frozen at the build checkpoint; motion after first scoring is a kill.

precedence.description: highest wins; must equal the memo section-3 order: withdraw, withhold, defer, dual_present, caveat, summarize, assert

rules.description: ordered; first match per evidence record wins. Table rules may output only assert, caveat, dual_present, withhold, or defer; summarize is a budget mechanism and withdraw a turn mechanism, both compiler-driven.

caveat_templates.description: one inline qualifier template per caveat reason_code; part of the frozen policy

render_templates.description: registered deterministic templates for adapter-rendered content, keyed by template id (bound into policy_version)

summarizer.description: deterministic extractive rule: first k-sentence prefix under the token cap; never a model
